name: Accessibility, WCAG 2.x A and AA plus best practice (all roles, profile tabs, payslip dialog)
tool: axe-core via Playwright, automated (6 tests, 3 browsers)
summary: All 6 accessibility tests pass on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; run by npm run qa:update

name: Keyboard order and focus ring on the login page
summary: Tab visits email, password, Login and the links in order; every stop shows a focus ring

name: Page speed, desktop
summary: First paint 0.19 to 0.25 s, no layout shift

name: Page speed, mid-tier phone (375 px, 4x CPU slowdown, 1.6 Mbps)
summary: Content shown: Login 1.4 s, Home 1.8 to 1.9 s, Payroll opened directly 2.1 to 2.2 s (was 2.7 to 2.95 s). Blocked time: Login 0.09 to 0.16 s, Home 0.20 to 0.28 s (both meet 0.3 s), Payroll direct 0.44 to 0.60 s (target 0.3 s)

name: Live sites: new build serves and works (GitHub Pages and Cloudflare)
summary: Both sites serve the 2026-11-28 build and pass 14 of 14 checks: the three fixes, on-demand pages, WebP login photo, encrypted payslip PDF, no console errors

name: Security headers on the live sites
summary: Still no Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy on either; HSTS on GitHub Pages only. Deferred until real hosting (decision D2)

name: Lint
summary: No ESLint config in the project

name: Screen reader and real-device testing
summary: Needs a person with NVDA or VoiceOver and a real phone

name: Full-frontend sweep: every page and tab, 3 roles, desktop and phone
tool: Playwright (e2e/full-frontend.spec.js), run with npm run qa:update:full
summary: 12 of 12 on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; 645 views, zero problems; slowest view is the Leave page animation at about 1.28 s
